events.title: Provisions gone
events.text: You open your box and half your provisions are gone: noodles, milk, Milo. Your bunkmate is pretending to sleep.

effects.result: He admits it and promises to replace them. Respect.

riskEffects.result: He swears it wasn't him. Now the room is tense.

effects.result: The official warns the whole hostel. Your things are safer now.

choices.label: Let it go and buy a padlock

effects.result: Lesson learnt. Your box is locked from now on.

events.title: Mosquito attack
events.text: It's 2am and mosquitoes are singing in your ears. You can't sleep.

choices.label: Buy a net tomorrow at Mammy Market

effects.result: You lose sleep tonight but you'll be prepared.
Sprayed. Everyone coughs, but you sleep.

events.title: Phone at 2%
events.text: Your mum is calling and your phone is about to die. The charging queue at Mammy Market is long.

effects.result: You catch her call. She sends her love.
Your platoon mate helps you out. New friend!
She'll worry, but you'll call tomorrow.

events.title: Hostel inspection
events.text: Soldiers burst into the hostel for a surprise inspection. Your bunk is a mess.

effects.result: You fixed it just in time. The soldier nods.
He walked past your bunk. Lucky.

riskEffects.result: "Whose bed be this?" Frog jump, 20 times.

events.title: Rain at parade
events.text: Heavy rain starts in the middle of the parade. Nobody is allowed to leave.

effects.result: Soaked but proud. The commandant praised your platoon.
A soldier saw you. Your name is written down.

events.title: Running stomach
events.text: That jollof from the kitchen was not your friend. Your stomach is turning.

effects.result: The nurse gives you ORS and flagyl. You rest for two hours.
It helps a bit.
Bad idea. You feel terrible all day.

events.title: Mammy Market haggling
events.text: Iya Basira wants N2,500 for rice, stew and meat. Your friends say it should be N1,800.

effects.result: She adds extra plantain. "My corper!"
She gives in. Good deal.

riskEffects.result: She hisses and serves you a small portion.

effects.result: You go back to camp food.

events.title: The snoring
events.text: Your bunkmate snores like a generator. It's 1am.

effects.result: He apologises and turns over. Peace.
You sleep with music playing. It works.
Very little sleep tonight.

events.title: Platoon needs you
events.text: Your platoon leader asks for volunteers to practise for the cultural dance competition.

effects.result: You join the dance group. Hard work, lots of fun.
Someone else takes your place.

events.title: Lost ID card
events.text: You can't find your camp ID card anywhere and there is a check at the hall entrance.

effects.result: Found it under your mattress. Phew.
The camp office prints a new one.

events.title: Birthday in the platoon
events.text: It's Ngozi's birthday and the platoon is contributing money for a small celebration.

effects.result: Cake, soft drinks and dancing at Mammy Market. Great night.
Small, but they appreciate it.
They noticed you didn't come.

events.title: "Business opportunity"
events.text: A smooth-talking corper says if you give him N5,000 now, his 'investment platform' will pay you N15,000 by passing out.

riskEffects.result: Two weeks later his number is switched off. It was a Ponzi scheme.

effects.result: He changes the topic and walks off. Good instinct.
You keep your money.

events.title: Light off
events.text: The camp generator goes off during a heatwave. The hostel is boiling.

effects.result: Cooler, but mosquitoes feast on you.
Sweaty, short sleep.

events.title: Strict soldier
events.text: The strictest soldier in camp catches your platoon talking during drill.

effects.result: "Next time, you will roll in the mud." You got away with a warning.
Your whole platoon does 50 frog jumps because of you.

events.title: Sleepy lecture
events.text: The lecture on road safety is long and the hall is warm. Your eyes are closing.

effects.result: You learnt something about defensive driving.
Nobody noticed. Nice nap.

riskEffects.result: An official taps your head in front of everyone.

events.title: Bank alert
events.text: Your uncle in Abuja sent you money with a message: "Make good use of your service year."

effects.result: You call him to say thanks. He's proud of you.

events.title: Water wahala
events.text: The taps are dry this morning. There's a long queue at the borehole with buckets.

effects.result: It takes 40 minutes but you bathe.
Expensive bath, but fast.
You spray perfume and hope.

events.title: Night party
events.text: Some corpers invite you to a secret party behind the hostels after lights out.

effects.result: Music, suya and laughter. You sneak back unseen.

riskEffects.result: Soldiers raid it. You are punished with grass-cutting.

effects.result: You wake up fresh while they look tired.

events.title: Someone likes you
events.text: A corper from Platoon 4 keeps smiling at you in the hall. Your friends are teasing you.

effects.result: You talk for an hour at Mammy Market. You exchange numbers.
Maybe another time.

events.title: Mammy Market date
events.text: Your camp crush asks you to share a plate of suya at Mammy Market tonight.

effects.result: Lovely evening. People are already calling you a couple.
Fair and fun. You laugh a lot.
They look disappointed.

events.title: Heat exhaustion
events.text: After hours in the sun you feel dizzy and weak.

choices.label: Drink water and rest in the shade

effects.result: You recover slowly.
Your head is pounding.

events.title: Camp pageant
events.text: Your platoon wants you to represent them in the Mr and Miss NYSC camp pageant.

effects.result: You walk the runway in Ankara. The crowd screams your platoon's name.
Someone else represents you.

events.title: Inter-platoon final
events.text: Your platoon reached the football final. The coach wants you on the pitch.

effects.result: You won! Your platoon carries you on their shoulders.

riskEffects.result: You lost 2-1, but you played well.

effects.result: Great atmosphere either way.

events.title: Corper in need
events.text: A corper in your hostel has no money left and hasn't eaten today.

effects.result: They thank you with tears in their eyes.
Noodles for two.
You feel bad about it later.

events.title: Camp radio interview
events.text: The OBS camp media team wants to interview you about camp life.

effects.result: Your voice is on camp radio. Friends tease you all day.
Maybe next time.

events.title: Posting rumours
events.text: Rumour says you can 'arrange' a good PPA posting by paying an official N20,000.

effects.result: Posting is supposed to be fair. You'll take what comes.
Nobody can confirm anything. You drop it.

riskEffects.result: Turns out it was a scam targeting corpers. You almost fell for it.

events.title: Customised khaki
events.text: A tailor at Mammy Market offers to customise your khaki with your name and state code.

effects.result: Your khaki looks sharp now.
You keep your money.

events.title: Missing home
events.text: Lying on your bunk, you miss home and your mum's cooking.

effects.result: Hearing their voices helps.
Turns out he misses home too. You bond.
It doesn't really help.
